labels.heading: Heading
labels.label: Label
labels.title: Title
labels.question: Question
labels.price_steps_help: Comma-separated prices in the shopper’s currency. Configure Price in Shopify Search & Discovery.
labels.open_cart_on_add: Open the bag after adding a product
labels.specifications_help: Use editable specification rows for each product family, or keep the five existing fields. Variant values override shared product facts. These descriptions do not verify vehicle fit.
labels.product_comparison_help: Show comparison controls on product cards and quick views. Turning this off also removes the comparison sidebar and dialog.
labels.show_product_ratings: Show ratings on product cards and quick view
labels.product_ratings_help: Uses the standard rating and review count supplied by your review app. Products without rating data stay unchanged. Add or remove the Rating summary block separately on product templates.
labels.compact_mobile_intro_help: On phones, show a short heading, search and a secondary shopping link. Hide the desktop slogan, description and photograph.
labels.mobile_heading_help: Describe what customers can shop for. Leave blank to use the translated Auto parts & accessories label.
labels.compact_mobile_links_help: Use two columns of short collection links on phones so products appear sooner.
labels.recommendation_heading_help: Explain whether these are alternatives, accessories or broader suggestions. Leave blank for the standard heading.
labels.compare_related_alternatives_help: Off by default. Enable only for related products that solve the same buying need. Requires global comparison. Complementary recommendations never show comparison. Selecting an item adds it to the existing comparison list; it does not automatically include the current product.
labels.spec_rows_key_help: List of Specification row metaobject references on products and variants. Each entry uses code, label and value fields. See the guide for setup and inheritance.
labels.compatibility_help: Show merchant-supplied requirements, exclusions and a reference for the selected variant. This feature does not match vehicles or confirm fit. Add the Compatibility & requirements block to product templates.
labels.compatibility_show_empty: Show an unknown state without a profile
labels.compatibility_show_empty_help: When off, products without a profile stay unchanged. Empty or inaccessible profile references still show Compatibility not confirmed.
